BIL_PAY_004: The behaviour under test IS verified: on 2026-09-08 this project approved bank transfer QA-TEST-DO-NOT-PROCESS-MTT9BVI94T7 and INV-20260908-000006 (14.00 EGP, MAH 5413868000009) moved to Paid at 01:58:22 with its Pay action withdrawn. But no single run has finished green, so it is recorded blocked rather than pass. That run exposed two defects in the case itself, both now fixed: (1) approving is gated by a native window.confirm which Playwright auto-dismisses, so the click was a silent no-op until a dialog handler was added; (2) settlement is asynchronous and the invoice list does not refresh itself, so a single assertion failed while the platform was correct. It now skips rather than fails when no claim of ours is awaiting review, which is the state immediately after a successful run because approving consumes the claim. A green end-to-end run needs a fresh cheap claim: the only pending invoice left for this MAH is INV-20260908-000002 at 4634.00 EGP, and settling that has not been authorised.
